name: Kebap Haus
kurzbeschreibung:
**Kebap House in Pfronten**

Welcome to **Kebap Haus** in the charming village of **Pfronten**—where authentic flavors meet Alpine freshness! Just a short drive from **Tirol’s** breathtaking landscapes, this cozy spot serves up mouthwatering **Döner Kebabs**, crispy **Döner Baguettes**, and juicy **Adana Kebabs**, all made with the finest ingredients.

Savor your meal with a cold **Tiroler Bier** or a refreshing **Apfelschorle**, and enjoy the warm, inviting atmosphere. Whether you're craving a quick bite after a day of hiking in the **Allgäu Alps** or a hearty dinner before exploring **Innsbruck** or **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, **Kebap Haus** delivers deliciousness with a smile.

Come taste the difference—where **Kebap** meets **Tirol**! 🍽️⛰️
